pages.quiz:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the plural of "die Banane"? (1 mark)
   A. die Bananen
   B. die Banane
   C. die Bananer
   D. die Bananes

2. Which phrase is correct for "in the garden"? (1 mark)
   A. an Garten
   B. im Garten
   C. in der Garten
   D. in die Garten

3. What does "die Küche" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. garden
   B. bathroom
   C. radio
   D. kitchen

4. How is "sch" pronounced in "Schule"? (1 mark)
   A. like ts
   B. like s
   C. like sh
   D. like k

5. What does "kochen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to sleep
   B. to smell
   C. to dance
   D. to cook

6. Which German word or phrase means "father"? (1 mark)
   A. die Familie
   B. die Mutter
   C. die Tante
   D. der Vater

7. Which little word goes with the noun "Wand"? (1 mark)
   A. den
   B. der
   C. das
   D. die

8. Why is "ich" written with a small letter in the middle of a sentence? (1 mark)
   A. It is a verb
   B. It is a place
   C. It is not a noun or a name
   D. It is always small

9. Which German word is the number 13? (1 mark)
   A. vier
   B. dreizehn
   C. zwölf
   D. eins

10. Which German word means "sunny"? (weather) (1 mark)
   A. kalt
   B. sonnig
   C. trocken
   D. heiß

11. What does "der Regenbogen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. fog
   B. rainbow
   C. snow
   D. cloud

12. Which German word means "strong"? (describing people) (1 mark)
   A. alt
   B. klein
   C. stark
   D. fleißig

13. Which food group does "der Apfel" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. das Gemüse
   B. das Fleisch
   C. das Obst
   D. die Getränke

14. What does "der Tee" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. milk
   B. egg
   C. tea
   D. bean

15. Which sentence is spelled and written correctly? (1 mark)
   A. Am Freitag singe ich.
   B. Am Freitag ich singe.
   C. am Freitag singe ich
   D. Am Freitak singe ich.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain why you should use reliable sources when you research a famous person's birthday. (2 marks)

17. Say why all nouns in a German text begin with capital letters and how this helps a reader. (2 marks)

18. Explain when to use "mein" and when to use "meine". Give one example of each. (3 marks)

19. Fill the gaps: "Das Buch ist ___ dem Tisch. Die Katze ist ___ dem Stuhl." Use auf and unter. (2 marks)

20. Write the German words with der, die or das for: clock, leg, house, spoon. (4 marks)

21. Write the German words with der, die or das for: arm, sister. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — die Bananen
   The plural of die Banane is die Bananen.

2. B — im Garten
   Garten is a der word: in dem = im.

3. D — kitchen
   die Küche means kitchen.

4. C — like sh
   German sch sounds like the English sh.

5. D — to cook
   kochen means to cook.

6. D — der Vater
   father in German is der Vater.

7. D — die
   It is die Wand, so the little word is die.

8. C — It is not a noun or a name
   Ich is only capital at the start of a sentence, unlike English I.

9. B — dreizehn
   13 in German is dreizehn.

10. B — sonnig
   sunny in German is sonnig.

11. B — rainbow
   der Regenbogen means rainbow.

12. C — stark
   strong in German is stark.

13. C — das Obst
   der Apfel belongs to das Obst.

14. C — tea
   der Tee means tea.

15. A — Am Freitag singe ich.
   Capital letters for Am and Freitag, correct spelling and a full stop.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: Some information is wrong; reliable sources have been checked.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each point.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: It is a spelling rule. Readers can spot the nouns quickly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the rule and 1 mark for the help.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Use mein with der and das nouns (mein Vater) and meine with die nouns and plurals (meine Mutter).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule and 1 mark for correct examples.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: auf; unter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

20. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Uhr, das Bein, das Haus, der Löffel.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (4 marks).

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Arm, die Schwester.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).
